title: Cumulative number of people who have ever reached space

source.name: Astronaut/space-traveler registry
source.publisher: Association of Space Explorers, as reported by Space.com

notes: 1961: Yuri Gagarin, the first person in space. 2020: approximately 560 people had reached space in the prior 59 years (widely reported figure, e.g. Astronomy.com; the 600th person reached space in November 2021 per PBS NewsHour). 2025: the 750th person reached space on June 29, 2025 via Blue Origin's NS-33 flight, per the Association of Space Explorers' registry as reported by Space.com.
